method: For every set, split and quality axis, each PDFluent configuration is paired with each reference (Docling standard, Docling minimal, pymupdf4llm) over the documents both of them scored. The number is the mean over those documents of (PDFluent - reference), each document's value being its own page mean, as in the report's headline. The interval is the paired bootstrap the engine uses (`pb_summary._bootstrap`: 2000 resampled means, seed 0, the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles), and a document counts up or down past +-0.005 (`pb_summary.PAIR_DELTA`).
